sloka: यानि भूतानि नगरे ऽप्यन्तर्धानगतानि च ।राघवं तान्यनुययुः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितम् ।। ७.१०९.२० ॥
transliteration: yāni bhūtāni nagare 'pyantardhānagatāni ca ।rāghavaṁ tānyanuyayuḥ svargāya samupasthitam ।। 7.109.20 ॥

translations.english: Even the invisible beings residing in the city followed Rama, who was ready to depart for heaven.
